name: Koukou Kyoushi ~Memories of Summer~
source:
Yamashina Shiroh is a high school teacher of physics in a private boys' school, which has just let out for summer vacation. Many attractive men and boys appear around Shiroh: former students, fellow teachers, a neighbor... Can Shiroh find a love over the summer vacation, or perhaps regain the memories of a past summer romance he's long forced from his mind?

[from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080213005100/http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/summer/summer.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
translation:
山科史郎是私立男子学校的高中物理教师，学校刚开始放暑假。史郎身边出现了许多迷人的男性与男孩：以前的学生、同事教师、邻居……史郎能在这个暑假找到爱情吗？或者，他能重新找回自己长久以来刻意遗忘的某段夏日恋情记忆吗？

[来源：[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080213005100/http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/summer/summer.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
